reference.question: \(P(A)=1/2\) and \(P(B\mid A)=1/3\). What is the probability that \(A\) and \(B\) both occur?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Apply the multiplication rule

By the multiplication rule: \(1/2\times 1/3=1/6\).
